note: Synthetic fake HOME with three VS Code chat sessions. Session files are fixtures written for this test, not captured from a real VS Code install. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds in the files and ISO-8601 UTC here. bytes = own file sizes plus the chatEditingSessions/<id> directory (for session 1). The scan never reads mtime for these sessions because each has request timestamps. Session 1 is a flat .json, session 2 is a .jsonl operation log, session 3 is an empty-window .json.
